label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 64
title: MVP: project creation wizard E2E (idea, dir, tiers/per-agent models, git, localization, branding, target, budget, integrations, template, team)
body:
Full project-creation workflow (owner). Fields:
- Idea / brief (free text; can be empty to let the agent ask later).
- Project name + slug + DIRECTORY (pre-populated default, editable).
- Model tier: select / customize / create a tier; PER-AGENT model assignment; BYOT keys.
- GIT / repository: connect an existing repo or create new; provider (GitHub/GitLab/other), remote URL, branch model (feat->develop->main), protected/base branches; optional worktrees.
- Deployment target: Vercel / managed cloud / self-hosted / remote Linux-Windows.
- LOCALIZATION: language, currency, date/time format, timezone, number format.
- Branding: project icon/logo, theme/design tokens.
- Budget/cost limits + license tier; integrations (advisor); pipeline template selection; team/tenant + who can access; notifications (email/webhook) preferences; ports/env config.
All captured up front; feeds project.json/project-config/tech-stack/git target config.
